text:
Sam (CEO): quick weekly check-in \u2014 a few priorities + housekeeping. please skim and flag blockers.
Sam (CEO): Policy change: hosted API default data retention will be 90 days unless customers opt-in to longer retention. Priya/Hana to finalize customer-facing language by Fri COB.
Sam (CEO): Private GA timeline: internal rollout planned next Wed; external invites to select pilots the week after. product & eng, confirm onboarding checklist green by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): Reliability note: canary yesterday exposed a memory leak in the continuous-batching code path. rollback executed, no customer impact. SRE/eng to do postmortem and mitigation plan.
Sam (CEO): Metrics snapshot: p50 improved 10% week-over-week; p95 increased ~8% due to the long tail. cost/token down 2%. focus on reducing p95 variance.
Priya - VP Product: acked. I'll draft the customer note for retention and add sample FAQ. Hana, please review and add legal phrasing.
Priya - VP Product: Private GA owners 3A I'll spin up a readiness checklist board. Diego, can you confirm the onboarding tests (kms, telemetry, schema validations) by Mon?
Diego - Eng Lead: ping received. PRs: #4998 (telemetry feature flag) and #5001 (batching leak hotfix). hotfix includes additional unit tests; staging redeploy planned tomorrow AM.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief: staging canary OOM at 01:47 UTC caused by unbounded batch accumulation when prefix length > 8k tokens. Rolled back to v1.23.9 at 02:05 UTC. No prod impact. Postmortem set for Thu 15:00 UTC in #incidents. Runbook updated: https://internal.runbooks/retry-batching-oom
Alex - Head of Sales: noted on GA timeline. Several trial customers asked about early access. If invites go out next week, we need a 1-paragraph outreach note + FAQs. Priya/Hana, can you provide that by Mon noon?
Hana (Legal): prefer exact phrasing: "Default retention 90 days; customers can request extended retention with contract terms". Will post redlines by Thu AM. Also confirm we include a data processing addendum link.
deploy-bot: deploy rollback: v1.24.0 -> v1.23.9 initiated by Morgan (SRE) at 02:05 UTC. log: "ROLLBACK: MEM_PRESSURE_DETECTED"
Diego - Eng Lead: suggestion: increase canary window from 30m to 2h for batch-sensitive releases and add kv-cache healthchecks. Will update rollout template.
Sam (CEO): agree. Diego/Morgan, coordinate on extended canary and update the rollout checklist.
Sam (CEO): two asks to org: A) If you own any GA deliverable, surface blockers by Mon 09:00 PT. B) if you're on the postmortem invite and can't make it, add notes into the doc beforehand.
Priya - VP Product: will own the GA readiness board and ping owners Mon 09:15 PT.
Alex - Head of Sales: I'll draft the outreach paragraph and share in this thread Mon noon.
Hana (Legal): posting redlines Thu am and will loop in compliance for DPA wording.
Morgan (SRE): postmortem doc and meeting link posted in #incidents. requesting Diego, infra, and one on-call dev to join.
Sam (CEO): thanks team. small, sharp week 2D keep updates here or DM me if urgent. :thumbsup:
__comments: Slack thread as a single string. Messages are chronological and short; no title field per agents.md rules.
